lazy_failure_attribution: Binary activation gate (35% threshold on 48-task window) never crossed; early tasks have lower hit rate than overall redundancy; 0/24 cells activated.
regime_target: ALL redundancy levels (0.0 to 1.0) -- threshold-free by construction
mechanism_hypothesis: By constructing a family certificate at the FIRST OBSERVED REPEAT (second occurrence of a structure key) and replaying on third+, we eliminate the binary activation gate. Cost structure: first = solve + key hash; second = construction + replay; third+ = replay only. This adapts to ANY redundancy level without a threshold.
mechanic_description: On-demand certificate construction at first repeat. For each structure key: track occurrence count. First occurrence: solve + cache with empty certificate. Second occurrence: construct certificate (intervention audit + family validation) + immediate replay. Third+ occurrence: replay from certificate only. No observation window, no activation threshold, no binary gate.

pre_registered_predictions.a_zero_repeat: Zero-repeat streams (redundancy=0.0) cost ≈ control + key-hashing overhead (near 0 net vs control). Every key occurs once, so construction never triggers; only key-hashing overhead paid.
pre_registered_predictions.b_break_even: Break-even at exactly 3 occurrences of a key. First = solve cost, second = solve + construction cost, third = replay only. Amortized construction across 3+ occurrences yields net benefit.
pre_registered_predictions.c_high_recovery: High-redundancy cells (redundancy >= 0.75) recover ≥ the #551 parent positive. The on-demand mechanic never blocks activation, so high-redundancy cells get the same or better certificate reuse benefit.
pre_registered_predictions.d_low_stay_near_zero: Low-redundancy cells (redundancy <= 0.25) stay ≈ 0 instead of -958 (lazy result). Construction only triggers on rare repeats; most tasks are first occurrences.

evaluation_gates.primary: All 24 cells >= control CI-touching-zero (net CI lower bound >= -control_margin or excludes zero from above)
evaluation_gates.secondary: High-redundancy cells (>=0.75) retain #551 parent positive (net CI excludes zero from above)
evaluation_gates.honesty: Charge full cost of key-hashing, construction, solve, and verify. All stage costs reported.
evaluation_gates.completeness: Three-way comparison: vs control, vs #551 FAMILY_CERTIFICATE_QUOTIENT, vs lazy #700 LAZY_FAMILY_CERTIFICATE_QUOTIENT

success_criteria.high_redundancy_positive: High-redundancy cells retain #551 parent positive (net CI excludes zero from above)
success_criteria.global_recovery: Aggregate net CI excludes zero from above OR straddles zero with positive mean (trend toward global)

honest_terminal_conditions.GLOBAL_POSITIVE: All gates met -- mechanic achieved global recovery
honest_terminal_conditions.EXTENDED_REGIME: Partial success -- high-redundancy positive but low-redundancy still negative OR aggregate negative but improved
honest_terminal_conditions.STILL_CONDITIONAL: Mechanic still regime-conditional -- no improvement over parent conditional verdict
honest_terminal_conditions.FAILED: No improvement over lazy or regression
